narr: Isolated flash flooding of roads occurred due to persistent thunderstorms with very heavy rainfall. Minor flooding ensued on the Little River at Hopkinsville. A 500 mb shortwave ejected eastward atop relatively stable low levels. Steep mid-level lapse rates promoted strong thunderstorm development. Precipitable water values were around 1.25 inches, contributing to torrential rainfall rates.
ev: A few state roads were closed by flash flooding of creeks. Kentucky Highway 994 was closed south of Lone Oak, Kentucky 339 was closed in the Mayfield Creek bottoms near Melber, and Kentucky 349 was closed near the Graves County line.
Kentucky Highway 1949 was closed at the Interstate 69 tunnel and the Smith Creek bridge.
